verdict.rationale: Claude Design has no dedicated CLI of its own. However, official docs say users can pull in a design system from Claude Code via /design-sync, work directly in Claude Code with /design, and hand off design bundles to Claude Code with a single instruction. That gives terminal-based access only through another first-party agent's slash commands. Missing for 10: a standalone official Claude Design CLI, documented commands and flags, CLI install and auth docs, and hands-on corroboration of /design usage from the terminal.
